TEXT: [FI] Hey Dad!!

TEXT: [FI] Hmm~? What's wrong, Yuuno?

TEXT: [FI] Don't wash your shirts together with my clothes!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Heh... So the time has come when I'm told those 
words by my daughter as well...

[FI] This daughter, who is exceptionally cute in looks 
alone, is Kousaka Yuuno.
[FI] She is Kirino's and my daughter.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] What are you muttering about? It's gross.
[FI] ...So this is the so-called rebellious age, huh?

[FI] How strange... Even though we put the character 
for "gentle" in her name, she didn't grow up to be 
gentle at all.

[FI] Her personality was just like her name until she 
was seven-years-old, and since then she's been like 
this.

[FI] By the way, when we were picking our daughter's 
name, it was serious business.

[FI] I was really scared that Kirino would give our 
daughter the name of a heroine from a H-game.

[FI] The way I searched through names one by one on 
the internet to decide on one, now that's a nostalgic 
memory for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Geez, you've grown up to be just like a certain 
someone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're so cute, damn it.
[FI] I pat her head as I say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT:
[FI] W-Why are you patting my head?! I don't get what 
you mean!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha, I see, I see.

[FI] If my wife saw this scene, she'd probably get really 
angry and scold me, but...
[FI] I really can't help myself.

[FI] This tsun-tsun response with such a damn cheeky 
attitude is just like Kirino from back then... It brings 
back a lot of memories.
[FI] Since it's unbelievably cute.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] S-Stop it.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Yuuno, shut up.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] O-Onii-chan.
[FI] Oh, Yuuno's natural enemy has appeared.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] Watch how you speak to your parents.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] B-But.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] G-Geez! It's Dad's fault that I got angry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ooh, my position sure is weak.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] It's your own fault you got angry, stupid.

[FI] And... the one talking down to my daughter is 
Kousaka Ryousuke.
[FI] He's the son I take pride in.

[FI] Kirino said that "He's just like you", but I think he's 
definitely similar to her.

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Apologize to Dad, then wash the clothes you wear 
yourself from now on.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] Eh~? Why should I do that?

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're so noisy, just be quiet and do it.

[FI] Whether in terms of his important-acting attitude or 
his appearance, he has without a doubt inherited 
Kirino's blood.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT:
[FI] Hah? What's with that way of talking? It's super 
annoying.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT:
[FI] Could you stop talking to me while being all 
condescending just because you were born before 
me?

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Regardless of whether you're my younger or older 
sister, I won't change my attitude.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] Heh, I wonder about that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yes, yes, that's far enough. Don't fight with me 
caught between you two.

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] It has nothing to do with you, Dad.

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, reflect on yourself when you're scolded, 
stupid.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT:
[FI] Hah? The one that calls others stupid is the stupid 
one!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah geez, why can't you two get along? Even 
though you're each other's only sibling.
[FI] I don't have the right to say that, though.

[FI] Although I understand now that I've become a 
parent and look at them, if I don't close my eyes to 
my own shortcomings, I can't lecture my children.

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yuuno is being noisy, so I'm going out to study.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] The library is closed today.

TEXT: [FI] I'm going over to Sensei's place.

TEXT: [FI] I see, then please give her my best regards.

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] Tch, what a good little child you are.

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Did you say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] Nothing. Give my best regards to the old hag.

TEXT: [FI] Sensei is still in her twenties!

TEXT:
[FI] And yet, she always dresses in clothes from the 
Taisho era.

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Leave her alone! There's nothing wrong with that!

before he leaves.
[FI] This is an everyday thing, so it can't be helped.

TEXT: [FI] I'm home!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] What, are you two fighting again? You two really 
never get tired of it.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] Mom, it's because Onii-chan...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Fuhihi, you're so cute, geez.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] I understand. Yuu-chan is acting like that because 
she wants her beloved Onii-chan to care about her, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] Wha-, t-that's not it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, yes, Mama understands everything.

SPEAKER: SPK_YUUNO
TEXT: [FI] I said that's not it~

SPEAKER: SPK_RYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Gross.
[FI] I can't tell whether these two get along or not.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Really now.

[FI] I'm very much pleased with this noisy home of 
mine.
[FI] I work in a company, Kirino's a professional model.

[FI] Since both parents work, I think it causes some 
trouble for our children.

[FI] Even so... Well, they seem to be growing up healthily, 
and I'm honestly happy about that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Hmm? What is it, Kyousuke?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Are you happy right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Of course I am.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Just like you.

[FI] We, who once quarreled with each other like that,
[FI] became husband and wife, and had children...
[FI] And have built a happy family like this now.

what he would say.
